backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister managing user profiles, settings, and session tracking with access control and pet/session type definitions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module passing old canister state through unchanged for upgrade compatibility.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend React files and components for reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app handling authentication, screen routing, session flow, mood/dialogue logic, and global providers.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, navigation, footer, and conditional playground background on the setup screen.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping actor calls for fetching and saving user profiles, settings, sessions, and adding new sessions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base layer with custom CSS variables for themes, dark mode overrides, and a pixel-art utility class.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App.
frontend/src/screens/ActiveSessionScreen: UI for an active focus session showing remaining time, pause/resume controls, end session button, and distraction check-ins.
frontend/src/screens/BreakRewardScreen.t: Displays break-time UI, saves completed sessions, and provides reward interactions for the user's pet.
frontend/src/screens/ProgressSettingsScr: Shows user progress and settings, allows editing focus/break defaults, platforms, and pet type, and saves settings.
Session setup form letting users choose pet type, durations, repeat cycles, and tasks before starting a session.
frontend/src/state/dialogue.ts: Pet dialogue sets for cats and dogs by mood tier, plus a function to fetch a random line for a given mood.
frontend/src/state/mood.ts: Defines mood tiers and thresholds for cats and dogs and computes mood tier based on interruption duration.
frontend/src/state/rewardReactions.ts: Maps pet type and action to short reaction strings for cat or dog.
frontend/src/state/sessionTypes.ts: Defines session configuration interface and session phase types.
frontend/src/state/useBehaviorMonitoring: React hook tracking inactivity, visibility changes, and manual interruptions to accumulate interruption duration.
frontend/src/state/useCountdownTimer.ts: React hook providing a simple countdown timer with start, pause, resume, stop, and reset.
frontend/src/state/useDialogueController: React hook selecting and periodically updating pet dialogue based on mood and session phase.
frontend/src/state/useMoodController.ts: React hook computing current pet mood from interruption duration and activity state.
Manages focus/break session state, timers, and transitions including repeating cycles and interruptions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from the URL/hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme colors, typography, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing app goals, features, architecture notes, and required assets.
